meta.title: Chinese Radical Lookup - S-Jiffy
ui.1: Query one Chinese character at a time; for multi-character input, only the first character is used.
ui.100: Please enter a Chinese character to look up
ui.101: Enter Chinese characters, e.g. 恩 江 森
ui.102: Radicals: indexing categories used by dictionaries to group characters by visual features, mainly for lookup - e.g. the Xinhua Dictionary groups Chinese characters into 189 radicals.
ui.103: Components: the building parts of compound characters that carry meaning or sound, and the units used for forming and recognizing characters - e.g. in 「江」, 氲 (semantic) and 工 (phonetic).
ui.11: Left-right (江), top-bottom (恩), left-middle-right (树), top-middle-bottom (意).
ui.12: Semi-enclosed (建), fully enclosed (国), triangular (晶), standalone (木).
ui.14: "; try a common Chinese character instead
ui.7: Components and radicals are often conflated, but they serve different roles:
ui.8: Inclusion: every radical is a component, but not every component is a radical; the same component may be classified under different radicals in different dictionaries.
ui.9: Standalone characters cannot be split into components and usually serve as their own radical, such as 「日」 and 「木」.
